blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Standard contrastive learning frameworks are mainly designed from a semantic perspective, yet learning 2D visual representations that preserve 3D spatial structure is also important for scene understanding. In this work, we propose Depth-Guided Contrastive Learning (DGCL), a simple auxiliary objective that injects 3D spatial awareness into 2D contrastive representation learning. Our key idea is to use depth to convert local 3D proximity into contrastive similarity: pixels that are closer in 3D space are encouraged to have more similar representations than pixels that are farther apart. Instead of relying on absolute depth values, DGCL formulates supervision through relative 3D distance comparisons among randomly sampled pixels, making the objective invariant to depth scale, efficient to compute, and easy to integrate into existing contrastive frameworks. Experiments across different datasets and models show that DGCL consistently improves 2D representation learning and benefits semantic downstream tasks by stronger spatial and geometric understanding. The code is available on https://github.com/LeungTsang/DGCL .
blocks.zh: 标准对比性学习框架主要从语义角度来设计,然而,学习保存3D空间结构的2D视觉表现对于场景理解也很重要. 在这项工作中,我们提出深度定向对比性学习(DGCL),这是一个简单的辅助目标,将3D空间意识注入2D对比性表达性学习中. 我们的关键想法是使用深度将本地的3D近似转换成对比性相似性:鼓励在3D空间中更接近的像素具有比距离更远的像素更相似的表示. DGCL不依靠绝对深度值,而是通过随机抽样的像素之间的相对3D距离比较来制定监督,使目标变异到深度尺度,计算效率,容易融入现有的对比框架. 跨越不同数据集和模型的实验显示,DGCL通过更强的空间和几何理解,不断改进2D表达式学习并有利于下游语义任务. 该代码可在https://github.com/LeungTsang/DGCL上查阅. 。 。 。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Self-supervised learning has become a central paradigm for learning transferable visual representations from large-scale unlabeled data [ 50 , 16 , 39 , 65 , 40 , 22 ] , including recently-introduced contrastive learning [ 8 , 27 ] , and masked image modeling [ 26 , 59 ] . Among different self-supervised objectives, contrastive learning remains a simple and effective framework by pulling positive samples closer in the embedding space while pushing negative samples apart [ 25 , 8 , 27 ] .
blocks.zh: 自我监督的学习已成为从大规模无标签数据[50,16,39,65,40,22]中学习可转移视觉表现的中央范式,包括最近引入的对比性学习[8,27],以及蒙面图像模型[26,59]. 在不同的自我监督目标中,对比性学习仍然是一个简单有效的框架,将正标本拉近嵌入空间,同时将负标本分开[25,8,27].

blocks.en: For contrastive learning, the key question is how to define meaningful positive and negative relationships. In traditional image-level contrastive learning, positive pairs are commonly generated from different augmentations of the same image, while other images are treated as negatives [ 55 , 8 , 27 , 24 ] . This simple assumption has proven effective for semantic representation learning, but it is less suitable for dense prediction tasks [ 37 , 18 , 15 , 67 ] , where meaningful visual information often lies in local structures and relationships between pixels or regions. Pixel-level contrastive learning addresses this issue by contrasting local features rather than only global image embeddings [ 41 , 51 , 58 , 4 ] . However, it also introduces a more challenging problem: how should the fine-grained similarity between pixels be defined?
blocks.zh: 对于对比性学习,关键问题是如何定义有意义的正反关系. 在传统的图像水平对比性学习中,正对通常由同一图像的不同增强生成,而其他图像则作为负对[55,8,27,24]处理. 这个简单的假设被证明对语义表达式学习是有效的,但是它不太适合密集的预测任务[37,18,15,67],其中有意义的视觉信息往往存在于像素或区域之间的局部结构和关系. 像素水平的对比性学习通过对比局部特征,而不是仅仅嵌入全球图像[41,51,58,4]来解决该问题. 然而,它也带来了一个更具挑战性的问题:应当如何定义像素之间细微的相似性?

blocks.en: Existing methods usually define pixel-level similarity from a semantic perspective. Some approaches rely on supervised or unsupervised object discovery and segmentation masks to relate pixels that are likely to belong to the same object or semantic category [ 66 , 64 , 51 , 58 , 53 , 47 ] . While effective, supervised priors reduce scalability, and unsupervised grouping methods can be sensitive to low-level appearance cues such as color, texture, and illumination. Other methods estimate pixel similarity from the learned feature space itself [ 51 , 58 , 53 ] , assuming that the learned representations are self-consistent. These approaches avoid external supervision, but their learned relationships may not necessarily correspond to semantics or physical structures.
blocks.zh: 现有方法通常从语义角度定义像素级相似性. 有些方法依赖有监督或无监督的物体发现和分块口罩来连接可能属于同一物体或语义类的像素[66,64,51,58,53,47]. 受监督的前科虽然有效,但降低了可扩展性,无监督的分组方法对低级的外观提示,如颜色,纹理,以及照明等,可能很敏感. 其他方法估计了从所学的特征空间本身[51,58,53]的像素相似性,假设所学的表达是自相容的. 这些方法避免了外部监督,但是它们所学到的关系可能不一定与语义或物理结构相对应.

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Overview of Depth-Guided Contrastive Learning (DGCL). In addition to the base contrastive objective, DGCL introduces an auxiliary pixel-level contrastive task guided by depth. Given a query pixel and randomly sampled anchor pixels, the anchor closest to the query in the 3D space reconstructed from depth is selected as the positive, while the others are treated as negatives. This nearest-anchor prediction objective converts relative 3D proximity into contrastive supervision, encouraging 2D features to capture local 3D structure.
blocks.zh: 图1:深度指导对比学习(DGCL)概况. 除了基础对比性目标外,DGCL还引入了以深度为引导的辅助像素级对比性任务. 鉴于一个查询像素和随机取样锚定像素,从深度重建的3D空间中最接近查询的锚定被选为正数,而其他的则作为负数处理. 这个最近的-anchor预测目标将相对的3D近距离转换成对比性监督,鼓励2D特性捕捉局部的3D结构.

blocks.en: In this work, we propose to define pixel-level similarity from a geometric perspective instead of treating pixel similarity as purely semantic. We does NOT assume that pixels close in 3D space necessarily share the same semantic label, nor use 3D proximity to approximate specific semantic classes. Our assumption is weaker: pixels that are close in 3D space are often physically or structurally related. They may lie on the same surface, belong to nearby interacting objects, or participate in local scene structures. Encouraging their representations to be correlated can therefore help the model learn 3D-aware local organization of the scene. Since 3D structure and semantic understanding are closely related in dense prediction tasks [ 32 ] , learning representations that better reflect the underlying 3D structure also benefits semantic downstream tasks.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们提议从几何角度来定义像素水平的相似性,而不是把像素的相似性当作纯粹的语义. 我们并不认为在3D空间中关闭的像素必然有相同的语义标签,也不使用3D近似来表示特定的语义类. 我们的假设比较弱:在3D空间中接近的像素往往在物理上或结构上相关. 它们可能躺在同一个表面,属于附近的相互作用物体,或者参与局部的场景结构. 因此,鼓励其表述相互关联,有助于模型了解3D-意识的现场地方组织。 由于3D结构和语义理解在密集的预测任务[32]中密切相关,因此更好地反映基础的3D结构的学习表现也有利于语义下游任务.

blocks.en: To this end, we introduce Depth-Guided Contrastive Learning (DGCL), an auxiliary objective that injects 3D spatial awareness into 2D contrastive representation learning. Given an RGB image and its depth map, DGCL randomly samples pixels as anchors and compares their relative 3D distances to each query pixel. For each query, the closest anchor in 3D is selected as the positive, while the remaining anchors are treated as negatives. This pretext task provides a complementary geometric signal, encouraging feature similarities to reflect 3D structure while the base contrastive objective preserves semantic invariance.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们引入了深度引导对比性学习(DGCL),这个辅助目标将3D空间意识注入2D对比性表达性学习中. 鉴于一个RGB图像及其深度映射,DGCL随机将像素作为锚点样本,并将其相对的3D距离与每个查询像素进行比较. 对于每个查询,3D中最接近的主锚被选为正主锚,而剩下的主锚则作为负主锚处理. 这种借口任务提供了一个互补的几何信号,鼓励特征相似性来反映三维结构,而基础对比性目标则保持语义上的无常.

blocks.en: DGCL is simple and versatile. First and foremost, DGCL relies on relative distance comparisons among sampled pixels within an image, instead of formulating a fixed transformation from absolute 3D distances to similarity scores, making the objective robust to depth scale. Secondly, DGCL make use of increasingly accessible depth from RGB-D sensors, synthetic environments, stereo systems, and especially modern monocular depth estimators [ 42 , 62 ] to enhance 2D visual representation learning, rather than using more expensive curated 3D datasets, point clouds, or camera trajectories. Finally, unlike multi-modal contrastive learning that aligns RGB and depth embeddings, DGCL directly constructs geometric supervision for RGB features without additional depth encoders. As a standalone module, it can be added to existing contrastive frameworks with minimal architectural modification.
blocks.zh: DGCL简单而多功能. 首先,DGCL依赖于图像内被采样的像素之间的相对距离比较,而不是形成从绝对的3D距离到相似性分数的固定转换,使客观的强度到深度尺度. 第二,DGCL利用从RGB-D传感器,合成环境,立体系统,尤其是现代单元深度估计器[42,62]中越来越容易获取的深度,加强2D视觉表现学习,而不是使用更昂贵的3D数据集,点云,或相机轨迹. 最后,与协调RGB和深度嵌入的多模式对比性学习不同,DGCL直接构建RGB特征的几何监督,没有额外的深度编码器. 作为一个独立的模块,它可以添加到现有的对比性框架中,并进行最小的建筑修改.

blocks.en: We summarize our contributions as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献总结如下:

blocks.en: • We propose Depth-Guided Contrastive Learning, a contrastive objective that uses relative 3D proximity to inject geometric awareness into 2D contrastive frameworks. • We show that DGCL consistently improves transfer performance across different contrastive frameworks, pretraining datasets, and downstream tasks.
blocks.zh: • 支助 我们提出深度指导对比性学习,这是一个对比性目标,利用相对的3D近距离将几何意识注入2D对比性框架. 我们显示,DGCL在不同的对比性框架、预训数据集和下游任务之间不断提高传输性能。

blocks.en: We propose Depth-Guided Contrastive Learning, a contrastive objective that uses relative 3D proximity to inject geometric awareness into 2D contrastive frameworks.
blocks.zh: 我们提出深度指导对比性学习,这个对比性目标使用相对的3D近距离将几何意识注入2D对比性框架.

blocks.en: We show that DGCL consistently improves transfer performance across different contrastive frameworks, pretraining datasets, and downstream tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们显示,DGCL在不同的对比性框架、预训数据集和下游任务之间不断提高传输性能。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Contrastive learning
blocks.zh: 2.1 相互矛盾的学习

blocks.en: Self-supervised visual representation learning has achieved strong transfer performance by exploiting supervisory signals derived from data itself. Among different self-supervised paradigms, contrastive learning is a foundational family of methods that learns an embedding space by pulling positive samples together and pushing negative samples apart [ 25 , 8 , 9 , 27 , 10 ] . Early methods typically define positive pairs as different augmentations of the same image and treat other images as negatives [ 8 ] , while later variants improve the objective through momentum encoders [ 27 ] , clustering [ 5 , 35 ] , asymmetric architectures [ 24 , 11 ] , redundancy reduction [ 3 ] , or information maximization [ 63 ] . These methods have proven effective for image-level recognition, where the instance-discrimination assumption provides a simple and scalable learning signal.
blocks.zh: 自我监督的视觉表现学习通过利用数据本身产生的监督信号,实现了强大的传输性能. 在不同的自我监督的范式中,对比性学习是一套方法的基础,这些方法通过把正样品拉在一起,把负样品推开来学习嵌入空间[25,8,9,27,10]. 早期方法一般将正对定义为同一图像的不同增强,并将其他图像视为负[8],而后来的变体通过动力编码器[27],集群[5,35],不对称架构[24,11],冗余还原[3],或信息最大化[63]来改进目标. 这些方法已证明对图像级别的识别是有效的,其中实例歧视假设提供了一个简单和可扩展的学习信号.

blocks.en:
Image-level contrastive learning is not always optimal for dense prediction tasks such as object detection [ 37 ] and semantic segmentation [ 18 , 15 , 67 ] , where local features and spatial correspondences are critical. To address this issue, many works extend contrastive learning to pixel-level [ 41 , 66 , 51 , 64 , 58 , 4 , 34 ] , patch-level [ 56 , 2 , 13 ] , region-or object-level [ 57 , 61 , 44 , 60 , 49 , 53 , 36 , 20 , 47 ] representation learning. In dense contrastive learning, the definition of the local similarity is a key design choice. Some methods derive similarity internally from the learned feature space itself, for example through online clustering [ 53 , 47 ] , nearest-neighbor matching [ 51 , 4 ] , or feature propagation [ 58 ] . Although these approaches avoid external supervision, the learned relationships may inherit appearance-level biases from RGB images, such as texture, color, dataset bias, or shortcut cues [ 21 , 43 ] .
Other methods introduce external priors, such as object proposals, segmentation masks, or hierarchical regions generated by supervised or unsupervised grouping models [ 66 , 29 , 52 ] .
These priors can provide more structured pixel relationships, but they may require additional models, preprocessing, task-specific assumptions, or supervised annotations.
blocks.zh:
图像级对比性学习并不总是对诸如物体检测[37]和语义分区[18,15,67]等密集的预测任务最优化,这些地方特征和空间对应关系都至关重要. 为了解决这个问题,许多作品将对比性学习扩展到像素级[41,66,51,64,58,4,34],补丁级[56,2,13],区域或对象级[57,61,44,60,49,53,36,20,47] 代表性学习. 在密集的对比性学习中,局部相似性的定义是一个关键的设计选择. 有些方法在内部从所学的特征空间本身获得相似性,例如通过在线集群[53,47],最近的邻里匹配[51,4],或特征传播[58]. 虽然这些方法避免了外部监督,但学到的关系可能继承了RGB图像的外观层次偏差,如纹理,颜色,数据集偏差,或快捷提示[21,43].
其他方法引入了外部前科,如对象建议,分块口罩,或由受监督或无监督的分组模型产生的等级区域[66,29,52].
这些前科可以提供结构化更强的像素关系,但它们可能需要额外的模型,预处理,任务特定假设,或有监督的说明.

blocks.en: Our method belongs to the family of pixel-level contrastive learning, but differs from prior work in how pixel similarity is defined. Instead of relying on semantic grouping or RGB-based feature similarity, we use depth to construct a geometric notion of similarity. The key assumption is that pixels close in 3D space are likely to be physically related and should therefore have correlated representations. In this way, DGCL introduces 3D spatial awareness into 2D contrastive representation learning while remaining a lightweight auxiliary objective that can be combined with existing contrastive frameworks.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法属于像素水平对比性学习的家族,但在像素相似性如何定义上与以前的工作不同. 我们不依靠语义分组或基于RGB的特征相似性,而是利用深度来构建一个几何概念的相似性. 关键假设是,3D空间中接近的像素可能与物理相关,因此应当具有相关表达. 这样,DGCL将3D空间意识引入到2D对比性表达学习中,同时仍是一个轻量级的辅助目标,可以与现有的对比性框架结合.

blocks.en: 2.2 2D representation learning with 3D information
blocks.zh: 2.2 利用三维信息进行二维代表学习

blocks.en: Learning 2D representations with 3D information has attracted increasing attention, as many visual tasks require not only semantic recognition but also spatial and geometric understanding. A common direction is to use RGB-D data, multi-view images, camera poses, point clouds, or reconstructed geometry to inject 3D priors into image encoders [ 31 , 38 , 7 ] . Such methods exploit correspondences across different views of the same scene, treating image regions that correspond to the same 3D point or region as positive pairs. Although effective, the requirement of structured data limits the broader applicability. Another line of work incorporates 3D information through multimodal or multitask pretraining. Multimodal contrastive learning can align RGB and depth representations in a shared latent space [ 48 , 23 ] , while masked image modeling approaches can train image encoders by jointly reconstructing depth, surface normals, or other geometric modalities [ 1 , 30 ] . However, these methods are often computationally expensive with additional networks to process different modalities and the learning of 3D awareness is mostly implicit.
blocks.zh: 学习带有3D信息的2D表达方式引起了越来越多的关注,因为许多视觉任务不仅需要语义识别,还需要空间和几何理解. 一个共同的方向是使用RGB-D数据,多视图图像,相机姿势,点云,或重建几何,向图像编码器注入3D前缀[31,38,7]. 这种方法利用同一场景的不同观点之间的对应,将对应同一立体点或区域的图像区域视为正对. 结构化数据的要求虽然有效,但限制了更广泛的适用性。 另一项工作是通过多式联运或多任务预先培训纳入三维信息。 多式联运对比性学习可以在共享潜在空间[48,23]中使RGB和深度表示一致,而蒙面图像模型方法可以通过联合重建深度,表面常态,或其他几何模式[1,30]来训练图像编码器. 然而,这些方法在计算上往往很昂贵,增加了处理不同方式的网络,学习3D意识大多是隐含的.

blocks.en: Depth has also been used more directly in dense contrastive learning. PixDepth [ 46 ] , for instance, improves pixel-level contrastive learning by using depth as an external cue to filter unlikely positive pairs in PixPro [ 58 ] . This is closely related to our motivation, but its formulation remains tied to a specific pixel-level contrastive framework and mainly uses depth to refine positive-pair selection. In contrast, DGCL formulates depth guidance as a standalone contrastive objective based on relative 3D proximity. Rather than thresholding absolute depth differences or aligning RGB features with a depth encoder, DGCL compares sampled pixels in 3D space and selects positives according to their relative closeness.
blocks.zh: 深度也更直接地用于密集的对比性学习. 例如,Pix深度[46],通过将深度作为外部提示来过滤 PixPro [58] 中不太可能的正对来改进像素级对比性学习. 这与我们的积极性密切相关,但其配方仍然与特定的像素级对比性框架联系在一起,并主要使用深度来完善正派选择. 相比之下,DGCL根据相对的3D相近性,将深度引导制定为一个独立的对比目标. DGCL与其阈值绝对深度差异或将RGB特征与深度编码器对齐,不如在3D空间中比较抽样的像素,并根据它们的相对近距离选择正数.

blocks.en: Compared with prior 3D-guided representation learning methods, DGCL has three distinctive properties. First, it only requires paired RGB images and depth maps, without camera poses, multi-view sequences, point clouds, or reconstructed scenes. Second, it uses relative 3D distance comparisons without relying on absolute metric depth, making it robust to different sources and scales of depth. Third, DGCL directly supervises 2D visual features with geometric relationships derived from depth, instead of treating depth as a reconstruction target or aligning RGB features with a separate depth embedding. Therefore, DGCL provides a simple and flexible way to inject 3D spatial awareness into 2D contrastive representation learning.
blocks.zh: 与之前的3D制导的表达学习方法相比,DGCL有三种独特的特性. 首先,它只需要配对的RGB图像和深度图,没有相机的姿势,多视图序列,点云,或者重建的场景. 第二,它使用相对的三维距离比较,而不依赖于绝对的度量深度,使其坚固到不同的来源和深度尺度. 第三,DGCL直接监督具有从深度衍生出来的几何关系的2D视觉特征,而不是将深度作为重建目标处理,或者将RGB特征与单独的深度嵌入相协调. 因此,DGCL提供了一个简单而灵活的方式,将3D空间意识注入2D对比性表达学习中.

The resulting 3D coordinates are not intended to provide a precise metric reconstruction of the scene. They serve as a geometric cue for comparing the relative 3D distances between sampled pixels. Moreover, DGCL is applied to feature maps with lower spatial resolution than the input image and therefore coarse 3D reconstruction is sufficient. The simplified back-projection makes the proposed objective applicable even when depth is estimated, scale-ambiguous, or obtained from different sources.
blocks.zh: 由此产生的3D坐标并不是为了对现场进行精确的计量重建. 它们是比较所取样像素之间相对的3D距离的几何提示。 此外,DGCL还应用于空间分辨率低于输入图像的特征地图,因此粗细的3D重建就足够了. 简化后期预测使拟议目标即使在估计深度、规模模糊或从不同来源获得深度时仍然适用。

blocks.en: 3.2 From 3D Proximity to Contrastive Similarity
blocks.zh: 3.2 从3D近似到对比相似

blocks.en: Given the back-projected 3D coordinates, DGCL converts 3D proximity into a geometric contrastive learning signal. A direct way would be to transform the absolute 3D distance between two pixels into a continuous similarity score. However, this is unreliable in practice. For example, two adjacent pixels on a distant background surface may have a larger 3D distance than two adjacent pixels on a nearby foreground object, although both pairs may represent locally coherent regions. In addition to the scene layout, the magnitude of 3D distance depends on the sources of depth with different camera intrinsics. Therefore, using a hand-crafted transformation can introduce undesirable scale dependence.
blocks.zh: 考虑到后期投影的3D坐标,DGCL将3D近距离转换成几何对比的学习信号. 一个直接的方法就是将两个像素之间的绝对3D距离转换成连续的相似度分数. 然而,这在实践中是不可靠的。 例如,远处背景表面的两个相邻的像素可能比附近前地物体上的两个相邻的像素有更大的3D距离,尽管这两对像素可能代表了局部连贯的区域. 除了场景布局外,3D距离的大小取决于不同相机内在的深度来源. 因此,使用手工制造的转变可造成不可取的规模依赖。

blocks.en: This formulation transforms 3D proximity into learnable feature similarity and the model learns to discriminate pixels according to their relative 3D distances. Our method does not rely on an absolute distance threshold, because the target is determined by the relative order of distances within each randomly sampled anchor group. Therefore, multiplying all 3D coordinates by a positive scale factor does not change the selected positive anchor. As a result, DGCL is robust to the metric scale of depth and can be applied to sensor depth, synthetic depth, or monocularly estimated depth.
blocks.zh: 这种配体将3D亲近转化为可学习的特征相似性,模型学习根据相对的3D距离区分像素. 我们的方法并不依赖于绝对距离阈值,因为目标是由每个随机取样锚组内距离的相对顺序决定的. 因此,将所有3D坐标乘以正尺度因素并不能改变选定的正锚. 因此,DGCL对深度的度量尺度是坚固的,可以应用于传感器深度,合成深度,或者单独估计深度.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: We perform extensive experiments to examine the effectiveness of DGCL in multiple scenarios. We integrate DGCL into MoCo v2 [ 10 ] , MoCo v3 [ 12 ] and SlotCon [ 53 ] , referred to as DGCL-M2, DGCL-M3, and DGCL-S, respectively, to study its interaction with different based methods in different scenarios. MoCo v2 and MoCo v3 are classic image-level contrastive learning methods using Resnet [ 28 ] and Vision Transformers [ 17 ] , respectively, and DGCL supplements it with a pixel-level learning objective. SlotCon features data-driven pixel grouping by prototypes and DGCL is expected to further improve its dense representation learning. The implementation is based on their official PyTorch codes. We compare DGCL with the immediate baselines to isolate the benefit of DGCL and other strong baselines to position the performance in the field. We report the average results of 3 independent runs and the standard deviations are provided in supplementary materials 3 .
blocks.zh: 我们进行了广泛的实验,以审查DGCL在多种情况下的有效性. 我们把DGCL整合到MoCo v2[10],MoCo v3[12]和SlotCon[53],分别称为DGCL-M2,DGCL-M3和DGCL-S,研究它与不同情景中不同基于方法的相互作用. MoCo v2和MoCo v3是经典的图像级对比学习方法,分别使用Resnet [28]和Vision Transformers [17],DGCL以像素级学习目标补充. SlotCon具有由数据驱动的像素分组的原型,DGCL有望进一步改善其密集的表示学习. 其实施基于其官方的PyTorch代码. 我们将DGCL与即时基线进行比较,以隔离DGCL和其他强基线的好处,将性能定位在外地. 我们报告3次独立运行的平均结果,标准差载于补充材料3。

blocks.en: 4.1 Pre-training on object-centric ImageNet
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 关于以对象为中心的图像的预训 净额

blocks.en: Implementation details We train a ResNet-50 [ 28 ] for 200 epochs and keep the training settings of the original base methods. We evaluate two variants: DGCL-M2, built on MoCo v2, and DGCL-S, built on SlotCon.
blocks.zh: 执行细节 我们为200个时代培训一个ResNet-50[28],并保持原有基础方法的培训设置。 我们评价两种变体:在MoCo v2上建的DGCL-M2和在SlotCon上建的DGCL-S.

blocks.en: Evaluation protocol We follow the evaluation protocol of SlotCon [ 53 ] and report transfer performance on COCO object detection and instance segmentation [ 37 ] , as well as semantic segmentation on Pascal VOC [ 18 ] , Cityscapes [ 15 ] , and ADE20K [ 67 ] . Additionally, we evaluate models on COCO keypoint detection. COCO tasks are evaluated with Detectron2 [ 54 ] while others use MMSegmentation [ 14 ] .
blocks.zh: 评价协议 我们遵循SlotCon[53]的评价协议,并报告COCO物体检测和实例分区的转移性能[37],以及Pascal VOC [18],Cityscapes [15],和ADE20K [67]的语义分区. 此外,我们还评估COCO关键点检测模型。 COCO任务用探测器2[54]来评估,而其他任务则使用MMSegment[14].

blocks.en: Transfer learning results Table 1 reports the transfer learning results after ImageNet pretraining. DGCL consistently improves its corresponding base method. Compared with the 200-epoch MoCo v2 baseline, DGCL-M2 improves COCO detection AP from 39.2 to 40.2 , mask AP from 36.1 to 37.1 , and keypoint AP from 66.0 to 66.6 . The improvement is also clear on semantic segmentation, especially on Pascal VOC, where mIoU increases from 72.4 to 76.2 . DGCL also improves the stronger SlotCon baseline. DGCL-S increases COCO detection AP from 41.8 to 42.1 , mask AP from 37.8 to 38.2 , and keypoint AP from 66.7 to 67.2 . Larger gains are observed on semantic segmentation, with improvements of 0.7 , 1.9 , and 1.5 mIoU on Cityscapes, Pascal VOC, and ADE20K, respectively. Notably, with only 200 epochs of pretraining, DGCL-S reaches comparable or better performance than DetCon trained for 1000 epochs. These results suggest that depth-guided local geometric supervision complements semantic grouping and improves the transferability of dense visual representations.
blocks.zh: 表1汇报了ImageNet预训后的转移学习结果。 DGCL不断改进其相应的基法. 与200世纪MoCo v2基线相比,DGCL-M2改进了COCO检测AP从39.2改进为40.2,遮罩AP从36.1改进为37.1,关键点AP从66.0改进为66.6. 在语义分割方面也有明显的改进,特别是在Pascal VOC方面,mIoU从72.4增加到76.2. DGCL还改进了更强的SlotCon基线. DGCL-S将COCO探测AP从41.8增加到42.1,遮蔽AP从37.8增加到38.2,关键点AP从66.7增加到67.2. 在语义分解方面观察到了较大的增益,城市景观方面的改进分别为0.7、1.9和1.5 mIoU,Pascal VOC和ADE20K。 值得注意的是,由于只有200个学期前培训,DGCL-S的成绩比DetCon为1000个学期培训的成绩要好。 这些结果表明,深度制导的局部几何监督是对语义分组的补充,提高了密集视觉表现的可转移性.

blocks.en: Table 1: Transfer learning results after ImageNet pretraining. DGCL consistently improves its corresponding base method across COCO object detection, instance segmentation, keypoint detection, and semantic segmentation. DGCL-S, trained for only 200 epochs, achieves performance comparable to or better than the 1000-epoch DetCon baseline on most metrics.
blocks.zh: 表1:ImageNet预训后转让学习结果. DGCL在COCO天体检测,实例分解,关键点检测,语义分解等全过程不断改进相应的基法. DGCL-S只为200个纪元训练,其性能可与大多数度量标准上1000个纪元的DetCON基线相比或更好.

blocks.en: 4.2 Pre-training on scene-based COCO
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 现场COCO培训前

blocks.en: Implementation details Following SlotCon [ 53 ] , we pretrain ResNet-50 on the COCO train2017 split [ 37 ] for 800 epochs. DGCL-M2 and DGCL-S use the same base training settings as their corresponding methods. The DGCL hyperparameters are kept unchanged.
blocks.zh: SlotCon [53] 之后的落实细节,我们预列了ResNet-50在COCO 2017列车的分拆[37] 800个世纪. DGCL-M2和DGCL-S使用与其相应方法相同的基础训练设置. DGCL 超参数保持不变。

blocks.en: Evaluation protocol We reuse the transfer evaluation protocol of SlotCon [ 53 ] , including COCO object detection, keypoint detection and instance segmentation [ 37 ] , as well as semantic segmentation on Pascal VOC [ 18 ] , Cityscapes [ 15 ] , and ADE20K [ 67 ] .
blocks.zh: 评价协议 我们重新使用SlotCon [53]的转移评估协议,包括COCO物体检测、关键点检测和实例分解[37],以及Pascal VOC [18]、Cityscapes [15] 和ADE20K [67]上的语义分解。

blocks.en: Transfer learning results Table 2 shows the transfer learning results after COCO pretraining. Compared with MoCo v2, DGCL-M2 brings substantial gains across COCO dense prediction and semantic segmentation tasks. It improves COCO detection AP from 38.5 to 40.1 , mask AP from 34.8 to 36.9 , and keypoint AP from 65.8 to 66.7 . The gains are even more pronounced for semantic segmentation, with improvements of 2.6 , 3.2 , and 2.7 mIoU on Cityscapes, Pascal VOC, and ADE20K, respectively. DGCL-S further improves the stronger SlotCon baseline. It increases COCO detection AP from 41.0 to 41.3 , mask AP from 37.0 to 37.9 , and keypoint AP from 66.3 to 67.4 . It also improves semantic segmentation by 0.5 , 1.1 , and 0.9 mIoU on Cityscapes, Pascal VOC, and ADE20K, respectively. DGCL-S achieves the best performance across all reported metrics. Compared with ImageNet pretraining, the gains from COCO pretraining are more consistent and larger, suggesting that depth-guided contrastive learning is particularly beneficial when pretraining on scene-centric images that contain richer spatial layout and geometric structure.
blocks.zh: 转让学习成果 表2显示COCO预训后转学结果. 与MoCo v2相比,DGCL-M2在COCO密集的预测和语义分解任务中带来了巨大的收益. 它改进了COCO检测AP从38.5到40.1,遮蔽AP从34.8到36.9,关键点AP从65.8到66.7. 在语义分解方面,收益更为明显,城市景点的改进分别为2.6、3.2和2.7 mIoU,Pascal VOC和ADE20K。 DGCL-S进一步改善了更强大的SlotCon基线. 它将COCO检测AP从41.0增加到41.3,遮罩AP从37.0增加到37.9,关键点AP从66.3增加到67.4. 它还在Cityscapes,Pascal VOC和ADE20K上分别改进了语义分解0.5,1.1和0.9 mIoU. DGCL-S在所有报告的指标方面都取得了最佳业绩。 与ImageNet预训相比,COCO预训的收益更加一致和更大,这表明当对包含更丰富的空间布局和几何结构的以场景为中心的图像进行预训时,深度引导对比性学习特别有益.

blocks.en: Table 2: Transfer learning results after COCO pretraining. DGCL consistently improves both MoCo v2 and SlotCon across COCO object detection, instance segmentation, keypoint detection, and semantic segmentation, indicating that depth-guided geometric supervision benefits pretraining on scene images. Moreover, DGCL-S achieves the best performance on all metrics.
blocks.zh: 表2:COCO预训后转学结果. DGCL 不断改进 MoCo v2 和 SlotCon 跨越 COCO 对象检测,实例分割,关键点检测和语义分割,表明深度导几何监督对现场图像有预先训练的好处. 此外,DGCL-S在所有指标上都取得了最佳业绩。

blocks.en: 4.3 Pre-training Vision Transformers
blocks.zh: 4.3 培训前愿景转换器

blocks.en: Implementation details Following MoCo v3 [ 12 ] , we train ViT-Small with patch size 16 for 300 epochs on ImageNet.
blocks.zh: 在MoCo v3 [12] 之后, 我们用补丁大小 16 来训练 ViT- Small, 在ImageNet上的 300 个时代 。

blocks.en: Evaluation protocol We evaluate the pre-trained models on COCO instance segmentation and Pascal VOC and ADE20k semantic segmentation. For COCO instance segmentation, we leverage ViTDet implemented by detectron2 with the default configuration and a batch size of 4. For semantic segmentation, we train UperNet with ViT backbone implemented by MMSegmentation [ 14 ] on Pascal VOC for 20k iterations and ADE20K for 40k iterations.
blocks.zh: 评价协议 我们评价COCO实例分解和Pascal VOC和ADE20k语义分解的预先训练模型。 对于COCO实例分割,我们利用通过探测器2执行的ViTDet,其默认配置和批量尺寸为4. 对于语义分区,我们用MMSegment[14]在Pascal VOC上实施的ViT骨干来训练UperNet,用于20k重联,ADE20K重联40k重联.

blocks.en: Transfer learning results Table 3 reports the transfer learning results and DGCL consistently improves MoCo v3. On COCO instance segmentation, DGCL-M3 improves mask AP from 33.7 to 34.9 , with gains of 1.6 AP 50 m \text{AP}_{50}^{m} and 1.5 AP 75 m \text{AP}_{75}^{m} . The improvement also transfers to semantic segmentation, where DGCL-M3 improves mIoU from 79.1 to 79.9 on Pascal VOC and from 39.4 to 40.7 on ADE20K. Compared with DINO [ 6 ] , DGCL-M3 obtains better performance on Pascal VOC but remains lower on COCO instance segmentation and ADE20K. This is expected, as DINO uses a different self-distillation framework and is pretrained for a longer schedule. The main comparison here is therefore between MoCo v3 and DGCL-M3 under the same contrastive pretraining framework. These results show that DGCL is not limited to convolutional networks and can also improve ViT-based contrastive representation learning.

blocks.en: 5 Ablation and Analysis
blocks.zh: 5 分析和分析

blocks.en: We conduct further experiments to analyze how DGCL compares with alternative ways of using depth, pseudo-mask guidance, and depth of different quality. Other hyperparameters are analyzed in supplementary materials 1 . Unless otherwise specified, we use MoCo v2 as the base contrastive framework and pretrain all models on COCO for 200 epochs with the same training setting.
blocks.zh: 我们进行进一步实验,分析DGCL如何与不同质量的深度、假面具引导和深度的替代方法进行比较。 在补充材料中分析其他超参数 1 (英语). 除非另有说明,否则我们使用MoCo v2作为基础对比框架,并预训COCO上的所有模型,用于200个具有相同训练环境的时代.

blocks.en: 5.1 Comparison with other methods that use depth
blocks.zh: 5.1 与其他使用深度的方法进行比较

blocks.en: We first compare DGCL with two alternative ways of incorporating depth into contrastive pretraining. The first baseline adds depth regression as an auxiliary pretext task, following the common practice of using depth prediction to encourage geometric understanding [ 31 ] by multi-task learning. The second baseline follows contrastive multiview coding (CMC) [ 48 ] , where RGB and depth are processed as different modalities and aligned in a shared embedding space. For a fair comparison, all methods are built on MoCo v2 and pretrained on COCO for 200 epochs. We evaluate transfer performance on COCO instance segmentation and semantic segmentation on Cityscapes and Pascal VOC.
blocks.zh: 我们首先将DGCL与将深度纳入对比性预训的两种替代方法进行比较. 第一个基线增加了深度回归作为辅助借口任务,遵循通过多任务学习来利用深度预测来鼓励几何理解的共同做法[31]. 第二个基准遵循对比性多视图编码(CMC)[48],其中RGB和深度作为不同模式处理,并在共享嵌入空间中对齐. 为了进行公平的比较,所有的方法都建立在MoCo v2上,并且预先在COCO上训练200个纪元. 我们评价城市风景区和Pascal VOC的COCO实例分区和语义分区的转移性能。

blocks.en: Table 4 reports the results. All depth-based objectives improve over the MoCo v2 baseline, confirming that depth provides useful geometric supervision for semantic representation learning. Among them, DGCL achieves the strongest performance across all metrics. The comparison suggests that how depth is used is important. Depth regression encourages the model to predict depth values directly, which may emphasize low-level local cues needed for depth prediction but less useful for semantic understanding. CMC aligns RGB and depth embeddings, but requires an additional depth branch and learns geometric information only implicitly through cross-modal representation matching. In contrast, DGCL provides explicit geometric supervision for representations without a depth encoder for embedding or a decoder for regression.
blocks.zh: 表4报告了结果。 所有基于深度的目标都比MOCo v2基线有所改善,证实深度为语义表达学习提供了有用的几何监督. 其中,DGCL在所有度量衡上都取得了最强的性能. 比较表明,如何使用深度很重要。 深度回归鼓励模型直接预测深度值,这可能会强调深度预测所需的低级局部提示,但对语义理解用处较小. CMC协调RGB和深度嵌入,但需要额外的深度分支,只通过跨模式的表示匹配来学习几何信息. 相比之下,DGCL为没有嵌入深度编码器或回归解码器的表示提供了明确的几何监督.

blocks.en: Table 4 : Comparison with alternative ways of using depth. All depth-based objectives improve the baseline, while DGCL achieves the best transfer performance without an additional depth encoder for embedding or decoder for regression.
blocks.zh: 表4:与使用深度的替代方法的比较。 所有基于深度的目标都改进了基线,而DGCL则在没有嵌入或解码回归的附加深度编码器的情况下实现最好的传输性能.

blocks.en: 5.2 Comparison with segmentation mask guidance
blocks.zh: 5.2 与分离罩制导的比较

blocks.en: We further compare DGCL with region-based guidance derived from segmentation masks. We consider masks generated by the Felzenszwalb-Huttenlocher (FH) segmentation algorithm [ 19 ] , masks generated by SAM [ 33 ] , and class-agnostic ground-truth COCO instance masks, demonstrated in Figure 3 . For each mask source, we compute a pooled region representation and use it as the positive target for pixels inside the corresponding region, forming an auxiliary pixel-level contrastive objective on top of MoCo v2.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步将DGCL与从分解口罩中得出的基于区域的指南进行比较。 我们考虑由Felzenszwalb-Huttenlocher(FH)分化算法产生的口罩[19],由SAM[33]产生的口罩,以及类不可知的地面-真相COCO实例口罩,如图3所示。 对于每个遮罩源,我们计算一个集合区域代表并将其作为相应区域内像素的正目标,在MoCo v2上形成一个辅助像素级对比目标.

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Class-agnostic masks by FH [ 19 ] , SAM [ 33 ] , and GT.
blocks.zh: 图3:按FH[19]、SAM[33]和GT分类的可知性口罩。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 5 , mask-based guidance consistently improves over MoCo v2, indicating that grouping pixels into object-like or region-like units is beneficial for dense representation learning. Stronger masks generally lead to better transfer performance: SAM outperforms FH, and ground-truth masks further improve the results while DGCL still achieves the best performance.
blocks.zh: 如表5所示,基于面具的引导比 MoCo v2 不断改进,表明将像素组合成类似对象或类似区域的单位有利于密集的表示学习. 更强的口罩一般会导致更好的传输性能:SAM的性能超过了FH,地面真实性口罩在DGCL仍然取得最佳性能的同时进一步提高了效果.

blocks.en: Table 5 : Comparison between segmentation mask guidance and depth-guided geometric guidance. Mask-based objectives improve MoCo v2 by grouping pixels within regions, while DGCL achieves stronger transfer performance by using relative 3D proximity to define pixel-level contrastive relationships.
blocks.zh: 表5:隔膜制导与深度制导几何制导的比较. 基于面具的目标通过在区域内组合像素来改进MoCo v2,而DGCL则通过使用相对的3D近距离来定义像素级对比关系来实现更强的传输性能.

blocks.en: This result highlights the difference between region-level grouping and geometric guidance and Figure 4 qualitatively compares the learned similarity maps. Mask-based objectives mainly encourage pixels within the same mask to have similar representations, but may not correctly relate different regions, especially across images. DGCL instead defines pixel relationships through relative 3D proximity, providing a complementary geometric signal that is not limited to object boundaries. Moreover, DGCL produces smoother feature maps than hard mask guidance, which may make the representations easier to adapt to downstream tasks. This helps explain why DGCL can outperform even mask guidance based on unlabelled ground-truth instance annotations.
blocks.zh: 这一结果突出了区域一级分组和几何指导之间的区别,图4则在质量上比较了学到的相似性地图. 基于面具的目标主要鼓励同一面具内的像素具有相似的表示,但可能无法正确连接不同的区域,尤其是跨图像. DGCL转而通过相对的3D近距离定义像素关系,提供一种不仅限于对象边界的补充几何信号. 此外,DGCL制作的特征图比硬面罩制导更平滑,这可能会使表示器更容易适应下游的任务. 这有助于解释为什么DGCL在未加标签的地面真实实例说明的基础上,甚至能够超越指导。

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Pixel similarity with respect to the reference pixel marked by the yellow cross + in the first image. Learning from either depth or class-agnostic GT tends to group the salient objects across different images regardless of their categories. However, DGCL may yield smoother geometry-aware similarity induced by relative 3D proximity for easier tuning in downstream tasks.
blocks.zh: 图4:在第一个图像中以黄色十字+标记的参考像素的像素相似性. 从深度或类不可知GT中学习,往往将不同图像的显著对象分组,而不论其类别如何。 然而,DGCL可能会产生相对的3D相近导致的较平滑的几何感知相似性,以方便下游任务的调谐.

blocks.en: 5.3 Sensitivity to Depth Quality
blocks.zh: 5.3 对深度质量的敏感性

blocks.en: We analyze how the quality of depth estimates affects DGCL. Specifically, we compare depth maps generated by different MiDaS models, whose relative depth quality is indicated by the MiDaS depth score [ 42 ] . Example depth maps are displayed in Figure 5 . We also include a trivial constant-depth baseline. In this case, the 3D distance degenerates to the planar 2D distance on the image plane, allowing us to examine whether the gain comes merely from 2D local spatial proximity.
blocks.zh: 我们分析深度估计的质量如何影响DGCL. 具体来说,我们比较了不同米达斯模型生成的深度地图,其相对深度质量由米达斯深度分数[42]表示. 示例深度地图如图5所示。 我们还包括一个微不足道的不断深入的基线。 在这种情况下,3D距离在图像平面上退化成平面上的平面2D距离,使我们能够检查收益是否仅仅来自2D局部空间相近.

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Depth maps generated by different MiDaS models [ 42 ] .
blocks.zh: 图5:不同米达斯模型生成的深度地图 [42].

blocks.en: Table 6 reports COCO object detection results after 200-epoch COCO pretraining. The constant-depth variant only brings a small improvement over MoCo v2, suggesting that simple 2D spatial proximity provides limited benefit. In contrast, using estimated depth substantially improves the baseline. Even the lightweight MiDaS Small 256 model improves AP b \text{AP}^{b} by 2.2 , showing that DGCL does not require highly accurate depth to be effective. Higher-quality depth generally leads to better performance, but the improvement saturates quickly. For example, stronger MiDaS models improve AP b \text{AP}^{b} to around 39.0 to 39.4 , with relatively small differences among Large 384 \text{Large}_{384} , DPT L − 384 \text{DPT}_{L-384} , Swin2 L − 384 \text{Swin2}_{L-384} , and BEiT L − 512 \text{BEiT}_{L-512} . This behavior is reasonable because DGCL is applied on feature maps, which is usually low-resolution. With a ResNet-50 backbone, a 224 × 224 224\times 224 input image is reduced to a 7 × 7 7\times 7 feature map, so fine-grained depth details are largely removed during downsampling. Therefore, coarse but reliable depth is already sufficient to provide useful relative 3D proximity for DGCL.
blocks.zh: 表6汇报了COCO在经过200年的COCO预训后检测结果. 恒深变体只会比MoCo v2带来小的改进,说明简单的2D空间近距离提供有限的好处. 相比之下,使用估计深度大大改善了基线。 即使是轻量级的MiDAS Small 256型号也通过2.2改进了AP b\text{AP}^{b},表明DGCL不需要高度精确的深度才能有效. 质量较高的深度一般会导致性能的提高,但改进的饱和度很快. 例如,较强的MiDAS模型将AP b\text{AP}^{B}改进到39.0到39.4左右,其中大384\text{Large}_{384},DPT L−384\text{DPT}_{L-384},Swin2 L−384\text{Swin2}_{L-384},BeiT L−512\text{BeiT}_{L-512}之间的差别相对较小. 这种行为是合理的,因为DGCL应用在特征地图上,通常低分辨率. 使用ResNet-50主干线,224×224\times 224输入图像缩小为7×7 7\times 7特性图,因此在下采样过程中,细纹深度细节基本被移除. 因此,粗糙但可靠的深度已经足以为DGCL提供有用的相对三维距离.

blocks.en: Table 6 : COCO object detection performance with DGCL pre-training on COCO for 200 epochs using depth of different quality by MiDaS [ 42 ] . DGCL substantially improves the baseline with only coarse depth estimated by a lightweight model, e.g., Small 256.
blocks.zh: 表6:通过DGCL预训对COCO进行COCO探测性能,使用MiDAS不同质量深度的200个纪元进行COCO探测[42]. DGCL大大改进了基线,只有轻量级模型估计的粗深,例如小256。

blocks.en: 6 Visualizations
blocks.zh: 6 视觉

blocks.en: We visualize dense representations in Figure 6 by computing the feature similarity between each pixel and a query pixel marked by the yellow cross. PixPro [ 58 ] tends to produce locally smooth similarity maps, reflecting its emphasis on spatially adjacent pixels by feature propagation. However, the resulting similarity may spread to regions that are close in the 2D image plane but less related in scene structure. MoCo v2 [ 10 ] , which is trained mainly with image-level contrast, produces less localized dense similarity. SlotCon [ 53 ] learns more structured regions through data-driven grouping, but the grouping can sometimes become overly coarse or fail to align with meaningful object parts, and the resulting similarity maps can become less discriminative. In contrast, both DGCL-M2 and DGCL-S produce similarity maps that are more concentrated around geometrically and semantically related regions.
blocks.zh: 我们在图6中通过计算每个像素和以黄色十字标记的查询像素之间的特征相似度,可以视觉到密集的表示. PixPro [58] 倾向于制作局部平滑相似度图,通过特征传播来反映其对空间相邻像素的强调. 然而,由此产生的相似性可能蔓延到2D图像平面中距离较近但与场景结构不太相关的区域. MoCo v2 [10] 主要由图像级对比法培训,产生较少本地化的密度相似性. SlotCon [53] 通过数据驱动的分组来学习结构化程度更高的区域,但分组有时会变得过于粗糙或无法与有意义的对象部分对齐,由此产生的相似性地图可能变得不那么具有歧视性. 相比之下,DGCL-M2和DGCL-S都生成了比较集中在几何和成像相关区域周围的相似度图.

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Visualization of dense feature similarity with respect to the query pixel marked by the yellow cross. Green indicates higher similarity and red indicates lower similarity. Compared with other contrastive baselines, DGCL produces similarity maps that better align with geometrically and semantically related regions.
blocks.zh: 图6:密集特征的可视化与以黄十字为标志的查询像素相似. 绿色表示较高的相似性,红色表示较低的相似性. 与其他对比基线相比,DGCL制作的相似度地图更能与几何和成像相关区域保持一致.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We presented Depth-Guided Contrastive Learning (DGCL), a simple auxiliary objective for injecting 3D spatial awareness into 2D contrastive representation learning. Unlike previous pixel-level contrastive methods that mainly define similarity from semantic perspectives, DGCL derives supervision from depth by assuming that pixels close in 3D space should have correlated representations. To avoid dependence on absolute depth scale, DGCL transforms 3D proximity into contrastive similarity through relative distance comparisons among randomly sampled pixels. This design makes DGCL easy to integrate with existing contrastive frameworks and applicable to depth maps from different sources, including estimated, synthetic, or sensor-provided depth. Extensive experiments across different datasets and models show that DGCL helps 2D representations explicitly capture 3D structure and consistently improves downstream transfer performance. Future work will explore how to better exploit fine-grained depth cues and higher-level 3D scene relationships, especially as stronger depth estimators continue to emerge [ 62 ] . We hope our work can inspire the research of representation learning with 3D awareness.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了深度指导对比性学习(DGCL),这是将3D空间意识注入2D对比性表达性学习的简单辅助目标. 与以往主要从语义角度定义相似性的像素水平对比方法不同,DGCL通过假设在3D空间中接近的像素应该有相关表示来从深度获得监督. 为了避免对绝对深度尺度的依赖,DGCL通过随机抽样的像素之间的相对距离比较,将3D近似性转化为对比相似性. 这种设计使DGCL易于与现有的对比框架融合,并适用于不同来源的深度图,包括估计、合成或传感器提供的深度。 跨越不同数据集和模型的广泛实验显示,DGCL帮助2D表示明确捕捉3D结构,并持续改善下游的传输性能. 未来的工作将探讨如何更好地利用精细的深度提示和更高层次的三维场景关系,特别是当更强的深度估计器不断出现[62]. 我们希望我们的工作能够激励人们研究通过3D意识来学习代表性。

blocks.en: 1 Hyperparameter Analysis
blocks.zh: 1 超参数分析

blocks.en: 1.1 Number of anchors K K
blocks.zh: 1.1 锚数 K K

blocks.en: As discussed in Section 3 , the number of anchors K K controls how concentrated the induced similarity is around each query pixel. A natural concern is that DGCL may require a carefully tuned K K to match the semantic granularity of the pretraining data or downstream tasks. We therefore study the effect of K K by pretraining DGCL with MoCo v2 on COCO [ 37 ] , which contains scene-centric images, and on a 118k-image subset of ImageNet [ 45 ] , which is more object-centric. The pretrained models are then transferred to downstream tasks with different semantic granularity, including COCO object detection, Pascal VOC semantic segmentation [ 18 ] , and Cityscapes semantic segmentation [ 15 ] . As shown in Figure 7 , DGCL is relatively stable across a range of K K , with the best performance consistently obtained around K = 8 K=8 . Very small or very large values lead to mild performance drops. When K K is too small, the nearest-anchor prediction task becomes less informative because the model only compares among very few candidates. When K K is too large, the sampled anchors are more likely to contain pixels extremely close to the query, making the task easier and less effective.
blocks.zh: 如第3节所讨论,锚数KK控制每个查询像素周围如何集中诱导的相似性. 一个自然的担心是,DGCL可能需要仔细调制的K K来匹配预训数据或下游任务的语义颗粒性. 因此,我们研究K K的效果,通过预训DGCL与MoCo v2对CO[37],包含以场景为中心的图像,以及对ImageNet的一个118k-图像子集[45],更以对象为中心. 然后,预先训练的模型被转移到具有不同语义颗粒性的下游任务,包括COCO对象检测,Pascal VOC语义分解[18],以及Cityscapes语义分解[15]. 如图7所示,DGCL在一系列KK中相对稳定,在K=8K=8左右持续获得最佳性能. 非常小或非常大的数值导致性能轻微下降. 当KK太小时,最近的锁定者预测任务变得信息较少,因为模型只比较极少数候选人. 当K K 太大时,被采样的锚更可能包含极接近查询的像素,使得任务更容易,效果更差.

blocks.en: Figure 7 : The best performance is consistently obtained around K = 8 K=8 and insensitive to the semantic granularity of either pre-training data or downstream tasks, indicating the improvement is due to the learned 3D spatial awareness from 2D instead of approximating specific semantic labels by tuning K K .
blocks.zh: 图7:最佳性能在K = 8 K = 8左右持续获得,对训练前数据或下游任务的语义颗粒性不敏感,表明改进是由于从2D学得的3D空间意识,而不是通过调试K K K 来近似特定语义标签.

blocks.en: 1.2 Number of anchor groups N N
blocks.zh: 1.2 主要群体数目 N N

blocks.en: The number of anchor groups N N controls how many independent nearest-anchor prediction tasks are constructed for each image in one iteration. A larger N N samples more anchor groups and therefore provides a smoother approximation of the rank-based 3D similarity distribution. As shown in Figure 8 , increasing N N improves transfer performance at first, and the performance saturates around N = 64 N=64 . We also measure the computational overhead of increasing N N using ResNet-50-based MoCo v2 with 224 × 224 224\times 224 inputs on two RTX 2080 Ti GPUs. Using N = 64 N=64 reaches the performance plateau while increasing the iteration time by only about 10%. It is also worth noting that additional memory usage is almost unnoticeable with N N smaller than 256. Therefore, we use N = 64 N=64 as the default setting in our experiments, as it provides a good trade-off between accuracy and efficiency.
blocks.zh: N N 控制了每个图像在一个迭代中构建多少个独立最近的-锁定预测任务。 一个更大的NN样本更多的锚组,因此提供了更平滑的基于阶次的3D相似度分布近似. 如图8所示,增加NN在一开始会提高转录性能,表现饱和度在N=64N=64左右. 我们还在两个RTX 2080 Ti GPU上测量使用基于ResNet-50的 MoCo v2 增加 N 的计算间接量。 使用 N = 64 N = 64 到达性能高原,同时将重复时间仅增加10%左右。 还值得注意的是,由于N小于256N,额外内存使用几乎是无法注意到的. 因此,我们使用N = 64 N = 64作为我们的实验中的默认设置,因为它在准确性和效率之间提供了良好的权衡。

blocks.en: Figure 8 : Increasing the number of anchor groups N N provides a smoother approximation of the 3D similarity distribution for learning in each iteration and improve the performance. The performance plateau is reached by 64 groups with only a 10% additional overhead, measured on 2 RTX 2080 Ti GPUs.
blocks.zh: 图8 :增加主播组 N N的数,为每个迭代的学习提供了3D相似度分布的更平滑的近似,并提高了性能. 性能高原由64个组达到,仅增加10%的间接费用,用2个RTX 2080 Ti GPU测量.

blocks.en: 2 Convergence
blocks.zh: 2 趋同

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 9 , DGCL improves convergence for both MoCo v2 and SlotCon. The advantage is especially clear in the early training stage, where training with DGCL achieves higher COCO detection AP and VOC mIoU than the corresponding baseline under the same number of pretraining epochs. It indicates that DGCL provides an effective additional learning signal, helping the model discriminate image contents and then learn transferable dense representations more efficiently. Such faster convergence is particularly useful when the pretraining budget is limited.
blocks.zh: 如图9所示,DGCL改进了MoCo v2和SlotCon的趋同。 在早期培训阶段,这一优势特别明显,与DGCL培训相比,在同等数量的预训时间下,COCO检测AP和VOC mIoU达到更高的水平. 它表明DGCL提供了有效的附加学习信号,帮助模型歧视图像内容,然后更高效地学习可转移的密集表示. 当培训前预算有限时,这种更快的趋同特别有用。

blocks.en: 3 Standard Deviations
blocks.zh: 3 标准偏离

blocks.en: To assess the robustness of the improvements, we report the mean and standard deviation over three independent runs in Table 7 and 8 corresponding to the main results in Table 1 and 2 . The small standard deviations indicate that the results are stable across runs, supporting the consistency of the gains reported in the main experiments.

blocks.en: 4 Per-Category Performance Gain
blocks.zh: 4 每个类别的业绩收益

blocks.en: To further examine whether the benefits of learned 3D awareness are general or the 3D proximity coincide with certain semantic categories, we analyze the per-category improvement in COCO instance segmentation, with categories ordered by their average object size. The gains are observed for most categories across small and large objects and across diverse object shapes. This suggests that DGCL does not simply exploit object-size bias or approximate particular semantic classes, but provides generalizable 3D-aware cues that benefit semantic tasks.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步审查学习到的3D意识的好处是一般的,还是3D的接近与某些语义分类相吻合,我们分析COCO实例分解的每个类别改进,分类按其平均对象大小排序. 对大小物体和不同物体形状的大多数类别都观察到这些收益。 这表明,DGCL并不只是利用对象大小的偏差或近似特定语义类,而是提供一般的3D-意识提示,有利于语义任务.

blocks.en: Performance drops mainly occur for small or thin objects, such as stop signs and parking meters, or small objects in cluttered contexts, such as oranges. These cases may be sensitive to depth errors and downsampling, where object pixels may be mixed with nearby background or supporting surfaces. Thus, local 3D proximity can sometimes conflict with instance boundaries. This is a limitation of DGCL, but the overall per-category trend suggests that the geometric signal remains beneficial for most classes.
blocks.zh: 性能下降主要发生在小的或薄的物体上,例如停止标志和停车表,或者在杂乱的上下文中小的物体,例如橙色. 这些案例可能对深度误差和下采样敏感,其中对象像素可能与附近的背景或支持的表面混合. 因此,本地立体邻近有时可能与实例边界冲突. 这是DGCL的限制,但总的每个类别的趋势表明几何信号仍然有利于大多数类别.

blocks.en: Figure 10 : Per-category COCO instance segmentation gains of DGCL-M2 over MoCo v2, with categories ordered by average object size. DGCL improves most categories across small and large objects, suggesting that the learned 3D-aware representation provides generalizable geometric cues. Negative gains mainly appear for small, thin, or cluttered objects potentially due to depth errors and downsampling.
